summary: Anissa Laverne Larson, 53, of Tucson, Arizona, slipped and fell an estimated 200 feet to her death from the Telluride Via Ferrata on the east end / south-facing wall of Telluride's boxed canyon while climbing with a friend; investigators ruled an unwitnessed misstep while unclipped west of the 'Main Event' section, with no mechanical failure or equipment malfunction; more than 30 responders hiked ~700 vertical feet to the scene and recovered the body via a technical rope system (911 call 11:30 a.m., all clear before 4 p.m.)
location: Telluride Via Ferrata, boxed canyon, east end of Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff Office; San Miguel County Search and Rescue; Telluride Fire Protection District
notes: Incident date Wednesday-verified (UN 2021-08-06 story: 911 call at 11:30 a.m. Wednesday; 2021-08-04 was a Wednesday); KVNF's 2021-08-09 newscast headline 'Tourist falls to her death off Via Ferrata in Telluride' = same incident, corroborating lead
